I don't ask for anything I don't think would benefit you as users, but I want to be clear on why Bleat asks for some things.

Identity

  • find accounts on the device

  • add or remove accounts

  • read your own contact card

I need this permission to be able to interact with the accounts that you create on the device.

Contacts

  • find accounts on the device

See identity.

Phone

  • read phone status and identity

I use this to determine if you're connected to the internet over 3g. If you've explicitly told my app to not use 3g, then this is useful.

Photos/media/files

  • read the contents of USB storage

  • modify or delete the contents of your USB storage

This is so you can save photos directly from bleat, or (in the future) upload them to a host when you wanna post a picture.

Storage

  • read the contents of USB storage

  • modify or delete the contents of your USB storage

See photos/media/files.

WiFi connection information

  • View wifi connections

I use this to check whether or not you're connected to the web. Thanks to this, if something goes wrong I can tell if it's because you're disconnected, and remind you about that.

Device ID & call information

  • read phone status and identity

See phone.

Other

  • View network connections: used for error handling

  • create accounts and set passwords: added security benefits of using Android OS instead of encrypting your sensitive info myself.

  • full network access: used to make requests to voat

  • use accounts on the device: self-explanatory

  • control vibration: notifications
